projects.title: Dayta
projects.overview: Processes multi-page academic schedules and course syllabi, generating high-density vector embeddings stored in Pinecone for rapid semantic search and conversational schedule querying.
highlights: Engineered an automated document ingestion pipeline converting multi-page academic schedules into high-density vector embeddings.
Implemented conversational guardrails with windowed session memory, confining responses strictly to official university data to eliminate hallucinations.
Built a lightweight, modular backend architecture utilizing FastAPI and asynchronous pipeline execution for sub-second query turnaround.

projects.title: Archivist
projects.overview: An autonomous GitHub Action utilizing LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to dynamically parse pull request diffs, achieving 100% automated enforcement of Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
highlights: Engineered an autonomous GitHub Action using LangGraph and MCP to dynamically parse PR diffs and enforce ADR compliance.
Enforced CI/CD governance via GitHub API, catching and blocking injected violations such as client-side secret leaks during pipeline simulations.
Reduced architectural review feedback loop from hours of manual inspection to under 60 seconds with a secure webhook-driven override command.

projects.title: GoCDC
projects.overview: A Go-based Change Data Capture (CDC) engine utilizing PostgreSQL WAL logical decoding to stream DML events to Redpanda and Kafka at 1,400 events/sec, completely eliminating database polling overhead.
highlights: Engineered a Go-based CDC engine streaming DML events to Redpanda at 1,400 events/sec utilizing PostgreSQL WAL logical decoding.
Architected a fault-tolerant polyglot persistence pipeline routing data from Postgres to Redis and MongoDB via Kafka with <150ms replication lag.
Containerized a 6-node microservice ecosystem using multi-stage Docker builds, reducing Go binary image sizes to 20MB.
